This is a lesson on one drum groove the [Backing Track](../../tools/backing-track.qmd) band plays: **Son clave (3-2)**. It is built up from a simpler pattern, one step at a time, and every step is played by the band and written out as it plays. How the examples work: press ▶ Play, switch players in and out with the buttons beside it, and read what the band will play on the staff underneath: the whole pass is written out when Play starts, before it sounds. The tempo slider at the bottom of the page slows everything down.

[All the accompaniment patterns](index.qmd) · [Drum grooves](index.qmd#drums)

## The pattern

The same groove as the 2-3 clave with its bars the other way round: three cross-stick notes in the first bar, two in the second.

It belongs in *Son montuno*. Here it is in the son montuno style with the whole band. Switch the other players off to hear it alone.

## Step 1: Son clave (2-3)

Start with something simpler. The 2-3 son clave on the cross-stick over two bars, a bell pattern on the cymbal and a light kick with the tumbao bass. A drum-kit part for the clave and timbales of a real section; the congas are a player of their own.

This is a pattern of its own: [the lesson on it](drums-clave.qmd) takes it further. Here it is only a step on the way, slowly. The drums play alone first; switch the bass and chords on when it is steady.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="montuno" data-chart="C|F|G7|C" data-tempo="70" data-on="drums" data-staves="drums" data-choice-label="Step:" data-choices='[{"label":"Son clave (2-3)","opts":{"groove":"clave"}}]'></div>

## Step 2: Son clave (3-2), slowly

Now the pattern itself. Compare it with the step before: press each button while the band plays and watch what changes on the staff.

**How to play it.** The same groove with its bars the other way round: three cross-stick notes in the first bar, two in the second. The tune decides which way round the clave goes.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="montuno" data-chart="C|F|G7|C" data-tempo="70" data-on="drums" data-staves="drums" data-choice-label="Compare:" data-choices='[{"label":"Son clave (3-2)","opts":{"groove":"clave32"}},{"label":"Son clave (2-3) (the step before)","opts":{"groove":"clave"}}]'></div>

## Step 3: Up to tempo, with the band

The whole band, at 100 beats a minute. Play along, then switch the band's drum kit off and take the part yourself.
